My dog needed a Bordetella vaccination for imminent boarding and vetco was recommended in a pinch. I set up an appointment, arrived 10 minutes early as specified but then had to queue up with several others and wait about 30 minutes in line. This needs to be communicated up front since it puts animals in close quarters, which doesn’t seem like the best practice.  They could call people up based on appointment or arrival time so people and pets can space out or walk around, there’s office space that’s was not in use. The vet techs were nice, and we got the vaccine administered just fine, but the invoice/receipt included a prescription for some tick and flea meds that was not discussed with me. Not sure if this was an error or a standard practice.
Thank you so much for the feedback, Gordon ! We are so glad that you are part of the THRIVE family. We appreciate the 5 stars!

Amazing experience.

Everyone from the doctor to the tech were so nice and showed my cat so much love. He was so calm the entire time that it was harder to get him to leave than it was to get him there in the first place. Definitely found out new go to vet!

Thank you for taking care of my furry family member!

friendly and informative staff

We have been a Vetco premier customer since 2022 normally use Poway or encinitas location. For the first time I thought I would use mission gorge on friars, well horrible service, the office staff gives you some hoopla story. I booked a follow up visit, and was called a couple hours before the appointment and was told that they couldn't see him because Poway saw him and it's really not a follow up. So I asked isn't Vetco the same she said yes but still. So why can't the Dr look at his weight and ears and log it down. She said well because Poway is the one that diagnosed him. It's ridiculous and to think I pay for this service, maybe it's time to look at other options. Which is sad because the doctor is great but the office staff will ruin it

Dr. Biggs and the whole staff were amazing. We felt like someone was actually listening to us. Our little girl is feeling much better from her ear infection, pain in her back legs and feet subsiding and anxiety reducing.

Excellent Service

Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

Do not take your pets to Petco Vetco; they only care about taking your money and care less for the health of your pets. My dog had an appointment in August 2025 for allergies. The Veterinarian recommended a different medication my bill came out around $400.00 dollars, and it was fine because she solved my dog's allergies problem. Before I left the veterinarian and her assistant told me that if my dog will have recurrent allergies before a year passed to call for more medication. After eight months, my dog started showing sings of allergies again. I called for refills, and they informed me that they would send a message to the veterinarian. After five days I called back, the person answering the phone told me that my dog needed a new evaluation and might need labs, and that the doctor was not comfortable refilling the medication for my dog. This person was very confrontational, cutting me off every time I tried to speak. I told her that I didn't need a year physical or labs for my dog. After I saw she was trying to force me to schedule another appointment so I could pay for things my dog doesn't need, I gave up. I told her that they were not honoring what they told me and that I would take my dog where they actually care for animals. She replied that that was fine and she would mail me my dog's records.
I am very disappointed. I have been taking my two dogs to the Petco clinic for years; I even paid upfront for a year for one of my dogs to be a member. I regret it, and I am ashamed to bring business to a company that is just trying to dig into people pockets. I just paid them more than $400.00 dollars two weeks ago for my other dog. It was very  bad experience, just a company that doesn't care for animals.

Jeannie And Dr. Johnson and their whole staff took the best care of our cat that we've ever seen. We've owned her for 10 years;  we've been to a lot of  local practices and none compare to the the care and professionalism that we received. Thank you for a great staff!
We Trust Vetco Immensely .They help with our dog.

I was sick of showing up at the vets office at 7 o’clock and waiting in line for two hours to get my pet seen. I decided to try Vetco and it has been wonderful! I’ve had Tess there three times and from the person out front on the computer to the vet tech and all the way to the veterinarian everyone is absolutely wonderful! Friendly, supportive, professional, and kind! I will never go anywhere else!
Staff was very nice, the Vet That was suppose to be there never showed up, but they quickly got another Vet there and everything went smooth.
Great experience. Didn’t try to upsell anything my kitten didn’t need.
Took Miss Bella Sue in for allergies. We had a wonderful experience. Dr Johnson and staff were all very nice and helpful. We will be coming back. 10/10 recommend

The doctor and vet tech were super helpful so nice the only problem was the receptionist who was an older woman, seemed like she was training someone else, and was so rude, also did not like her attitude or customer service. First of all, I did not like how she talked to the vet tech questioning why she changed the name on the account holder second she didn’t want to check or scan my coupon because she believed I was there before when this was sent to my email. She didn’t care to say “Of course let’s see if the coupon works” She probably judged me to be a liar/fraud of some sort. She tried to reimburse after saying some things to each other in front of a crowd after paying the full amount. Will I go back… maybe but I might consider switching to a different vetco or going to a different place. Don't want to deal with that kid of people the first thing you walk in.

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Johnson! She has been absolutely amazing with our French Bulldog. Her loving and compassionate approach immediately puts both us and our pup at ease. Dr. Johnson takes the time to explain everything thoroughly, ensuring that we fully understand the situation and feel confident in her care. What truly sets her apart is her dedication—she even checks in the next day to see how our pup is doing, which means so much to us as pet owners. If you're looking for a veterinarian who genuinely cares and goes above and beyond, Dr. Johnson is the one. We are so grateful to have her caring for our furry family member!
Lovely staff, clean hospital and friendly doc.
Everyone at this location is amazing!! Super nice and knowledgeable!!

Spend the extra money and go to a real vet.
Going to Vetco is like going to SportClips for a haircut — but instead of a bad haircut that grows back, you’re risking your animal’s health and well-being.

This location only cares about taking your money; they show no real concern for your pet’s care. I took my dog in for an eye infection and was prescribed antibiotics without any testing or examination — in and out in five minutes and $150 paid.

Weeks later, my dog’s condition had worsened. When I went to another Vetco location for an emergency, that vet told me it was negligent to prescribe antibiotics without running tests first, as it can lead to antibiotic resistance.

When I reached out to the manager of this Vetco location, I received zero resolution, zero sympathy, and zero care.

Do yourself, your pet, and your wallet a favor — find a real veterinary practice that actually cares about your animal’s health.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
The vet and vet assistant were awesome!

I am very disappointed with the service and subsequent billing from this chain vet. During my initial visit at a different location, the doctor failed to perform the essential diagnostic step: checking for a ruptured eardrum before prescribing ear drops which would be contraindicated if eardrum is not intact. This crucial misstep meant I had to return for a second, unnecessary visit just to correct their mistake.
​To avoid the clinic that made the error, I went to another Vetco location for the follow-up. I had a coupon for first visit which saved me $90 (so my bill was $125. still -so expensive!) for the initial visit and was then unjustly charged a full $90 for the quick check-up visit at this location, which was required solely due to the chain's prior clinical oversight. Charging a customer to fix a clinic error is unprofessional, and it makes the original "coupon" feel like a scam rather than a good deal.
